usfmStyleUrl.description: URL or workspace-relative path to the USFM style file (vendored path preferred for deterministic regeneration)
usfmStyleUrl.x-prompt: What is the URL or path of the USFM style file?

outputPath.description: Where to save the resulting file. Only libs/shared/src/utils/usfm works as-is: the generated defaultStyleInfo.ts imports StyleInfo from the hand-written ./styleInfo.js next to it, so any other output path emits an unresolvable import.
